title: Certificate Transparency, e-mail security posture and RDAP names (batch p1-G01-1)
owner: batch p1-G01-1 (P001 ct_logs/ct_logs_extra, P002 email_security_posture, P003 rdap)
notes: P002 cond 9 asks for spf_lookups, spf_void_lookups, dmarc_pct, dmarc_sp, dmarc_rua_external, dkim_selectors, mta_sts, tls_rpt and bimi in core/vocab.py; batches never edit core files, so they live here until the core adopts them (core request).

attributes.first_cert_seen: ISO date: earliest not_before among the Certificate Transparency certificates naming the domain - a lower bound of its age, never a registration date
attributes.wildcard_cert: list of wildcard names ('*.example.com') seen in certificates under the domain: wildcard coverage of the parent, never a host name
attributes.shared_cert: list of shared (multi-tenant CDN/hosting) certificates naming the domain ({issuer, not_before, san_count, registrable_domains, reason}): never affiliate evidence
attributes.ct_summary: Certificate Transparency summary: {cert_count, unique_names, first_cert_seen, issuers [[issuer, count]], top_names (20), sources}
attributes.ct_names_historical: names found only in Certificate Transparency that answer NXDOMAIN through DoH (historical: passive modules only)
attributes.ct_names_unresolved: names found in Certificate Transparency whose DoH check could not be verified (SERVFAIL, timeout): neither live nor historical
attributes.spf_lookups: int: DNS-mechanism lookups of the SPF evaluation (include, a, mx, ptr, exists, redirect; RFC 7208 limit 10)
attributes.spf_void_lookups: int: void lookups (NXDOMAIN or no records) of the SPF evaluation (RFC 7208 limit 2)
attributes.spf_includes: list of {domain, vendor, depth, via}: domains reached through SPF include:/redirect=, with the SaaS/ESP vendor when known
attributes.spf_status: SPF evaluation outcome: ok | none | permerror | temperror | could_not_verify
attributes.third_party_mail_cidrs: list of {cidr, vendor, via}: netblocks authorised through SPF include: of SaaS/ESP mail providers (third_party_mail: never the organisation's netblocks)
attributes.dmarc_pct: int: DMARC pct= tag (0-100) of the applicable policy
attributes.dmarc_sp: DMARC sp= tag (subdomain policy): none | quarantine | reject
attributes.dmarc_rua_external: list of {dest_domain, authorized}: DMARC rua/ruf destinations outside the organisational domain and whether <domain>._report._dmarc.<dest> authorises them (true/false; null = could not verify)
attributes.dkim_selectors: list of common DKIM selectors with a published (non-revoked) key; absence means 'not determined', never 'DKIM missing'
attributes.mta_sts: {present, id}: MTA-STS TXT record (_mta-sts.<domain>); the policy file itself is fetched by wellknown_files (P065)
attributes.tls_rpt: {present, rua}: SMTP TLS reporting TXT record (_smtp._tls.<domain>)
attributes.bimi: {present, logo, authority, declined}: BIMI TXT record (default._bimi.<domain>)
attributes.mail_providers: list of mail SaaS/ESP vendors inferred from SPF includes and MX hosts (e.g. 'Google Workspace', 'Microsoft 365')
attributes.email_posture: e-mail security posture summary table {spf, spf_lookups, spf_void_lookups, dmarc, dkim, mta_sts, tls_rpt, bimi, caa, dnssec, mx}
attributes.registered: bool: the authoritative registry holds a registration for the name (False only from the authoritative RDAP server's 404)
attributes.registrant_kind: kind of registrant in the registry answer: org | individual | redacted
attributes.privacy_proxy: bool: the registrant data is a privacy/proxy or registrar-generic value (shown as 'redacted (privacy)'; never a pivot or a cluster key)
attributes.cnpj_roots: list of 8-character CNPJ roots of the registrant (branch registrations link to one company)
attributes.registrar_iana_id: IANA registrar id of the sponsoring registrar (takedown packet, P345)
attributes.abuse_phone: abuse telephone of the registrar or network (role contact only)
attributes.delegation_signed: bool: the registry reports a DNSSEC-signed delegation (RDAP secureDNS.delegationSigned)
attributes.rdap_server: host of the RDAP server that answered (authoritative registry, or the rdap.org fallback)
attributes.rdap_contacts: list of role/abuse contacts kept from the registry answer ({roles, org, email, tel}); natural persons are never kept
attributes.rdap_network: {start, end, cidrs, name, handle, type, parent_handle}: IP network object of the RIR answer
attributes.rdap_autnum: {start, end, name, handle, type}: AS number object of the RIR answer
attributes.brand_match: org_profile brand keyword found in the label of an individual-held .br name (feeds typosquat scoring, P028)

tags.third_party_mail: SaaS/ESP mail infrastructure authorised by an SPF record: never the organisation's netblock, never a reputation or attack-surface subject, never an ACTIVE scope

relations.has_certificate: domain -> SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate issued for it (Certificate Transparency)
relations.spf_include: domain -> domain included by its SPF record (include:/redirect=)
relations.spf_authorized: domain -> CIDR/IP authorised by a direct ip4:/ip6: mechanism of its own SPF record (candidate netblock until RDAP/NIC.br confirms ownership)
